purpose: Teach: シーア/難関/人民元/ウイグル/最高峰/浙江/広州/天空

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、中東イスラーム派閥でシーア派の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered Shia Islamic movements in the Middle East for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Patient pause before the student's name. Genuinely interested, inviting confirmation rather than testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、最難関大学入試研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about university entrance exam preparation and the most competitive universities.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. Clear and direct without rushing. Slight lift at the end showing she's done her work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人民元の国際化を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you explored the internationalization of the Chinese yuan in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, curious tone. Reflective pacing. Leaning forward slightly, genuinely wanting to hear what she discovered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ウイグル自治区の経済を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the economic landscape of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region.
lines.style: Clear, direct delivery. Confident in her topic without being defensive. Steady eye contact, answering fully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世界最高峰の山岳研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also researched mountaineering at the world's highest peaks for your paper, correct?
lines.style: Engaged and attentive. Slight warmth in tone. Natural, conversational rhythm. Genuine follow-up, not interrogative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、浙江省の経済発展を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I covered the economic development of Zhejiang Province.
lines.style: Measured response. Quiet competence. Not elaborate, but complete. Eyes steady, accepting the acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 広州の貿易拠点研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you looked at Guangzhou's role as a major trading hub, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Paced to let the student respond naturally.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、天空望遠鏡の観測史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the observational history of the Tianyan radio telescope.
lines.style: Final confirmation, delivered with quiet pride. Steady, composed. Slight breath at the end, closing the exchange.
